items.description: Open a section detail page whose section has 4 past-dated planner tasks across 3 distinct dates (one date has 2 tasks).
items.expected_result: The "Days Worked" card shows 3 (distinct dates, not task count).

items.description: With a future-dated planner task present on that section, confirm it appears under "Upcoming Work".
items.expected_result: "Days Worked" is still 3 (future task not counted).

items.description: With a rolling (Kanban) task present on that section, confirm it appears on the Kanban.
items.expected_result: "Days Worked" is still 3 (rolling task not counted).

items.description: Scroll the metric cards at the top of the section page.
items.expected_result: No "Total Litter Bags" card anywhere; exactly 4 cards: Days Worked, Total Plants, Weeds Removed, Days in Stage.

items.description: Open a section with no past-dated planner tasks.
